parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 suggests structural overlap between `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 164), the two methods belong to distinct test classes that verify different behavioral contracts — core state after stop vs. idempotency of play-after-stop — so their surface similarity is intentional test-fixture duplication, not accidental redundancy. Merging or extracting them into a shared helper would obscure the distinct intent of each test class and couple unrelated behavioral assertions. No production code is involved, so no refactor is warranted.
